scope: Canonical multi-donor abstraction layer for serial surrogate-satisfaction loop design before bounded realization.

core_loop_law.one_line: Each episode should convert visible pressure into visible progress, lock a private satisfaction receipt, trigger observer reevaluation, and open the next gate without exhausting future beats.
success_conditions: The protagonist creates visible headway inside the current episode.
Reward is converted into a structural asset, access shift, authority shift, or durable receipt instead of generic profit alone.
At least one observer or gatekeeper visibly reevaluates the protagonist.
The episode ends with a legal next gate rather than a hollow cliffhanger.
failure_modes: Setup-only delay with no visible proof or receipt.
Public proof with no private receipt or access lock.
Reward is flattened into generic admiration, profit, or reevaluation language.
The next gate is opened by consuming a future beat instead of a lawful bridge move.
The protagonist receives gifted access instead of earned access.

generalized_mapping_examples.minimum_truth: A gatekeeper who previously constrained the protagonist visibly changes posture after proof.
A private structural receipt proves that the protagonist now occupies a privileged operating position.
The current episode opens a specific, higher-order lane for the next episode or tranche.
The protagonist is granted a privileged execution or approval lane unavailable to ordinary actors.

donor_integration_contract.purpose: A donor provides evidence, examples, and mapping hints. It does not replace the canonical loop law.
new_donor_rules: Every new donor must be reduced to generalized slots before it is allowed to influence canonical material-side law.
A donor may extend mapping examples, reward rotation notes, and contamination red flags without rewriting the core loop law by default.
Conflicts between donors should be resolved at the generalized slot layer, not by importing donor-specific nouns into canonical law.
A donor is accepted only if it improves loop evidence, not merely style or novelty.
must_translate_not_copy: public proof to private receipt structure
red_flags: donor proper nouns or organizations survive unchanged in canonical law
donor scenery replaces the abstract mechanic
proof is narrated as cleverness without a visible event
public spectacle appears without private satisfaction receipt
repeated donor-flavored receipts narrow the reward portfolio

evaluation_contract.minimum_acceptance_rule: An episode should satisfy at least four loop-contract items, and it should not miss both receipt_visible and next_gate_visible at the same time.

merge_policy: Core loop law changes require stronger evidence than donor annex updates.
New donors may enrich examples and reward classes without immediately changing canonical thresholds.
Canonical law remains donor-free even when multiple donors are active.
